name: es-foral-income-tax-foreign-assignment
description: Apply the 2026 foral exemption for employment work physically performed abroad by an ordinary resident employee of Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa or Navarra. Covers the eligible work and beneficiary conditions, the annual caps, specific and nonspecific pay, the literal day worksheet for part-year and successive employers, day and denominator boundaries, the excess-regime election, the foreign-tax credit on the nonexempt part, and exemption interactions. Use for exención por trabajos realizados en el extranjero, artículo 9.17, artículo 7(n) Navarra, desplazados, régimen de excesos, impatriados versus expatriados and doble imposición in the foral territories. Load es-foral-income-tax for residence, bases and the annual return. Split unchanged from es-foral-income-tax on 6 November 2026.
